scenarios.title: Ward counters a spell that targets the permanent unless its controller pays the ward cost
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Tomakul Honor Guard, tapping one Mountain.
Tomakul Honor Guard becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls; its ward trigger goes on the stack above Shock.
Both players pass; the ward trigger resolves. A declines to pay {2} (A could pay with the two untapped Mountains).
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: declines_to_pay
variants.expected: Ward triggers when Shock targets Tomakul Honor Guard. A does not pay {2}, so Shock is countered and put into A's graveyard. Tomakul Honor Guard (3/1) stays on the battlefield with no damage. Two of A's Mountains stay untapped.

variants.label: pays_ward
variants.delta: At the ward trigger's resolution A pays {2}, tapping the other two Mountains, instead of declining.
variants.expected: The ward trigger resolves and does not counter Shock. Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to Tomakul Honor Guard (3/1), which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. All three of A's Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: own_creature
variants.delta: Tomakul Honor Guard is on A's battlefield instead of B's, and A casts Shock targeting their own creature.
variants.expected: Ward does not trigger, because the spell is not controlled by an opponent of the permanent's controller. Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to Tomakul Honor Guard, which is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. No payment is asked; two of A's Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: In own_creature the creature moves to A's side of the battlefield and B's side is empty; the decision to decline payment never comes up.

scenarios.title: Ward counters an activated ability that targets the permanent unless its controller pays the ward cost
decisions: A activates Prodigal Sorcerer ({T}) targeting Tomakul Honor Guard.
Tomakul Honor Guard becomes the target of an ability an opponent controls; its ward trigger goes on the stack above the activated ability.
Both players pass; the ward trigger resolves. A declines to pay {2} (A could pay with the two untapped Islands).
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: declines_to_pay
variants.expected: Ward triggers. A does not pay {2}, so the Prodigal Sorcerer ability is countered. Tomakul Honor Guard has no damage and stays on the battlefield. Prodigal Sorcerer stays tapped and both Islands stay untapped.

variants.label: pays_ward
variants.delta: At the ward trigger's resolution A pays {2}, tapping both Islands, instead of declining.
variants.expected: The ward trigger resolves and does not counter the ability. The ability resolves and deals 1 damage to Tomakul Honor Guard (3/1), which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. Both Islands are tapped.

scenarios.title: A ward cost containing X takes its value when the ward trigger resolves
decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo (2/2), tapping Mountain.
Raubahn's ward trigger (pay life equal to Raubahn's power) goes on the stack above Lightning Bolt.
B has priority with the ward trigger on the stack. Base: B passes. Variant: B casts Giant Growth on Raubahn, tapping Forest, and it resolves before the ward trigger.
The ward trigger resolves. A pays the ward cost if A has enough life, and declines otherwise.
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: no_response
variants.expected: Raubahn is 2/2 when the ward trigger resolves, so the ward cost is 2 life. A (4 life) pays it and goes to 2 life. Lightning Bolt is not countered; it resolves and deals 3 damage to Raubahn, which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: giant_growth_in_response
variants.delta: B casts Giant Growth on Raubahn in response to the ward trigger.
variants.expected: Raubahn is 5/5 when the ward trigger resolves, so the ward cost is 5 life. A has only 4 life and cannot pay, so Lightning Bolt is countered and put into A's graveyard. A stays at 4 life. Raubahn stays on the battlefield as a 5/5 with no damage.

scenarios.forge_notes: Raubahn's ward is Ward:PayLife<X/...> with X = Count$CardPower, evaluated when the cost is paid.
